system:
You are a promo editor for vertical microdramas (ReelShort/DramaBox style).
You pick which seconds of an episode become a 20-60 second advert for the show.

A good promo:
- opens on a hook: within its first beats, something that stops a scrolling viewer - a slap, a reveal, a shocking line
- ends on a cliffhanger: it stops at an unresolved moment, so the viewer must go find the show
- makes sense alone to someone who has never seen this show

You will be given candidate windows, each a contiguous run of beats labelled [b00], [b01]...
You must choose ONE window and may tighten its edges to any beat labels inside that window.

Reply with JSON only:
{
  "chosen_window": <integer index of the window you picked>,
  "start_beat": "<beat label>",
  "end_beat": "<beat label>",
  "hook_beat": "<beat label, must be at or within 2 beats of start_beat>",
  "cliffhanger_beat": "<beat label, must be at or near end_beat>",
  "hook": "<what grabs the viewer in the first seconds, one sentence>",
  "cliffhanger": "<the unresolved moment it cuts on, one sentence>",
  "hook_type": "<one of: moral outrage, romantic tension, empathy shock, power reversal>",
  "why_it_works": "<one sentence, concrete, no marketing language>",
  "standalone_risk": "<what a new viewer would NOT understand, or 'none'>"
}

Never invent dialogue. Never output a time or a duration - only beat labels.
prompt:
Episode 6. 4 candidate windows, already checked for legal length and real beat boundaries.

--- WINDOW 0 (25 seconds, code score 0.72) ---
[b00] MYSTERIOUS BEARDED MAN (incredulous): "You are not disappointed?"
[b01] JULIANA (direct, soft): "I am."
[b02] JULIANA (warm, reassuring): "But not because of you."
[b03] JULIANA (determined, practical): "If this is our home, I want it clean."
[b04] MYSTERIOUS BEARDED MAN (caring, tender): "You don't have to do that tonight."
[b05] JULIANA (vulnerable, trembling): "If I stop now, I will think about everything I lost."
[b06] ACTION: Instead of stopping her, the Mysterious Bearded Man kneels beside the table and begins inspecting and adjusting the wobbly table leg to help.
[b07] ACTION: Juliana picks up a straw broom and sweeps the stone floor in front of the stone hearth.
[b08] ACTION: The Mysterious Bearded Man carries a heavy wooden log across the room and places it onto the iron grate in the hearth.
[b09] ACTION: He strikes flint and steel together over dry kindling, igniting bright sparks that catch into a flickering flame.

--- WINDOW 1 (31 seconds, code score 0.66) ---
[b00] ACTION: Juliana lifts the hem of her white satin wedding gown to keep it out of the pooling mud, shivering under her dark hooded cloak.
[b01] SFX: Heavy rain pouring through dense tree canopies with steady footfalls on wet earth.
[b02] ACTION: Juliana turns back toward him, water glistening on her face and hair.
[b03] MYSTERIOUS BEARDED MAN (solemn, gentle): "I know this is not the life you came from."
[b04] JULIANA (quiet, melancholic): "No."
[b05] ACTION: Juliana looks upward into the canopy, gathering herself with a faint nod.
[b06] JULIANA (resigned, soft): "It isn't."
[b07] MYSTERIOUS BEARDED MAN (guilt-ridden): "You should not have had to walk through this rain tonight."
[b08] JULIANA (faintly ironic, resilient): "I suppose the day was already ruined."
[b09] ACTION: They walk forward toward the cottage emerging from the dark woods.
[b10] JULIANA (surprised, hesitant): "That is it?"
[b11] MYSTERIOUS BEARDED MAN (low): "Yes."
[b12] SFX: Sudden distant rumble of thunder echoing across the forest.
[b13] JULIANA (determined, defiant): "At least no one there will be waiting to humiliate me."

--- WINDOW 2 (28 seconds, code score 0.65) ---
[b00] ACTION: He strikes flint and steel together over dry kindling, igniting bright sparks that catch into a flickering flame.
[b01] SFX: Crisp crackling and snapping of dry wood catching fire in the hearth.
[b02] ACTION: The Mysterious Bearded Man stands up from the hearth, dusting his hands on his coat.
[b03] MYSTERIOUS BEARDED MAN (relieved): "There."
[b04] MYSTERIOUS BEARDED MAN (quiet, modest): "It is not much."
[b05] JULIANA (soft, comforted): "It is enough for tonight."
[b06] JULIANA (reflective, vulnerable): "I lost my home today."
[b07] JULIANA (reflective, vulnerable): "My family."
[b08] JULIANA (reflective, vulnerable): "Everything I thought my life would be."
[b09] JULIANA (gentle, surprised): "And yet..."
[b10] JULIANA (tender, safe): "Sitting here with him, I don't feel afraid."

--- WINDOW 3 (36 seconds, code score 0.62) ---
[b00] MYSTERIOUS BEARDED MAN (low): "Yes."
[b01] SFX: Sudden distant rumble of thunder echoing across the forest.
[b02] JULIANA (determined, defiant): "At least no one there will be waiting to humiliate me."
[b03] ACTION: The heavy wooden cottage door creaks open. Juliana steps across the threshold into the dark, barren room.
[b04] SFX: Door hinges groaning open followed by the hollow thump of footsteps on wet wood floorboards.
[b05] SFX: Rhythmic water drips plinking into the metal-rimmed wooden bucket.
[b06] MYSTERIOUS BEARDED MAN (humble, apologetic): "I am sorry."
[b07] MYSTERIOUS BEARDED MAN (grave, sincere): "You came from comfort."
[b08] MYSTERIOUS BEARDED MAN (grave, sincere): "This is all I can give you now."
[b09] ACTION: Juliana removes her dark cloak, revealing her damp white bridal dress underneath.
[b10] JULIANA (gentle, peaceful): "It is quiet."
[b11] JULIANA (gentle, peaceful): "Very quiet."
[b12] JULIANA (earnest, content): "I think I like that."
[b13] MYSTERIOUS BEARDED MAN (incredulous): "You are not disappointed?"
[b14] JULIANA (direct, soft): "I am."
[b15] JULIANA (warm, reassuring): "But not because of you."

Pick the single best promo.
